title: Plant Image Data Engineering
reason: Dataset cleaning, manifests, source tracking and leakage work exist, but real ESP32-CAM greenhouse ingestion and verified plant/session identity are not yet completed.

title: Annotation & Dataset Quality Layer
reason: Dataset QA, duplicates and split auditing exist, but the authoritative architecture requires YOLO bounding-box annotation/validation; current production evidence is classification-oriented.

title: Image Quality Gate
reason: Computer-side image-quality gate and recapture/failure handling are implemented.

title: Image Preprocessing
reason: Preprocessing is implemented and classification preprocessing parity was explicitly repaired and validated.

title: Controlled Data Augmentation
reason: Training used controlled augmentation, but the full architecture-level versioned augmentation experiment matrix is not yet closed.

title: Core Computer Vision Engine - YOLO11n
reason: YOLO11n classification is trained and validated for tomato and pepper, but the PDF architecture also requires region/bounding-box and affected-area outputs.

title: Visual Stress Feature Engine
reason: No direct implementation evidence for the required visual feature vector including affected-area, color, texture and relative visual change.

title: Plant Baseline / Delta Intelligence
reason: Baseline/delta concepts and contracts exist, but reproducible per-plant healthy baseline and validated color/texture/affected-area deltas are not fully closed.

title: Temporal Plant Analysis Dataset
reason: A valid temporal plant dataset requires repeated time-aligned observations of the same real plant under controlled conditions.

title: Early Stress Detection Analysis
reason: Early-stress lead-time validation requires real temporal plant evidence; classification data cannot establish pre-symptomatic lead time.

title: Model Training & Experiment Management
reason: Config-driven training, experiment evidence, seeds and reproducible tomato/pepper training records are present.

title: Computer Vision Model Evaluation
reason: Held-out classification evaluation, confusion matrices, accuracy and Macro F1 are complete, but PDF detection-oriented mAP/region evaluation is not applicable to the current classification-only branch.

title: Computer Vision Error Analytics
reason: Saved error predictions and confusion/error-pair analytics exist, but full causal/environmental error categorization and required FP/FN report structure are not yet fully closed.

title: Active Learning Layer
reason: Human-review active-learning queue is implemented; automatic labeling, retraining and actuation are explicitly disabled.

title: Vision Explainability Layer
reason: Validation-only Grad-CAM explainability with preprocessing parity is complete for tomato and pepper.

title: Transfer Learning & Crop Adaptation Layer
reason: Tomato-to-pepper adaptation experiment and held-out pepper evaluation exist, but selected-backbone freezing was not documented and transfer superiority was not established.

title: Model Export & Portability
reason: PyTorch-to-ONNX export and prediction parity are validated for both crops.

title: Vision Model Registry & Release
reason: Versioned research-only registry, model hashes, routing and abstention behavior are implemented.

title: Sensor Data Ingestion
reason: Sensor schema/validation contracts exist, but real physically-present sensor ingestion has not yet been validated.

title: Sensor Feature Engineering
reason: Sensor validation infrastructure exists, but the complete versioned feature-engineering pipeline with moving averages/deltas/rates is not closed.

title: Image / Sensor Time Synchronization
reason: Image/sensor timestamp synchronization and stale/missing-window handling are implemented computer-side.

title: Multimodal Feature Fusion
reason: Fusion contracts/schema exist, but no validated multimodal feature model has yet been trained/calibrated.

title: Sensor-Only Baseline Model
reason: Sensor-only baseline model required for ablation is not implemented.

title: Vision-Only Risk Baseline
reason: Vision-only operational risk baseline is not implemented as a comparable risk estimator.

title: Multimodal Stress Fusion Engine
reason: Fusion contracts exist, but a trained lightweight multimodal stress fusion model with validated metrics is still missing.

title: Stress Risk Score Engine
reason: Risk/output scaffolding exists, but a calibrated fused 0-100 Stress Risk Score is not yet validated.

title: Risk Calibration & Threshold Optimization
reason: Threshold/safety concepts exist, but probability calibration and validation-derived operational thresholds are not closed.

title: Temporal Intelligence Engine
reason: Required bounded-memory risk trend, velocity and acceleration engine has no direct implementation evidence.

title: Predictive Risk Forecasting Engine
reason: Predictive Risk Engine with configurable horizons and naive-baseline comparison is not implemented.

title: AI Uncertainty & Out-of-Distribution Layer
reason: Low-confidence/image-quality/missing-data safety behavior exists, but complete explicit uncertainty/OOD state handling is not yet closed.

title: Vision / Sensor Conflict Detection
reason: Conflict-safe behavior is represented in contracts/safety logic, but formal validated vision-vs-sensor conflict detection is not yet closed.

title: Decision Intelligence Engine
reason: Decision/safety scaffolding exists, but the complete deterministic multimodal decision engine depends on unfinished risk/forecast layers.

title: Decision Safety Layer
reason: Safety gate blocks autonomous action, but the full config-driven operational policy with calibrated risk, confirmation counts and cooldown is not yet closed.

title: Decision Reason & Multimodal Explainability
reason: Structured reasoning concepts exist, but full multimodal reason codes and technically valid fusion feature-contribution explanations are unfinished.

title: Master AI Inference Pipeline
reason: Vision inference exists, but the complete master pipeline through sensor validation, fusion, risk, temporal forecast and decision cannot be complete until upstream missing modules are implemented.

title: AI Gateway & Backend API
reason: FastAPI gateway exists with core endpoints, but the final architecture API surface and completed intelligence fields are not yet fully delivered.

title: Standard AI Output Contract
reason: Versioned output schema exists, but risk/forecast/fusion fields are not yet backed by completed models.

title: Hardware Integration Interface
reason: Computer-side standardized actuator/hardware contract exists and direct electrical actuation is correctly separated from AI.

title: Hardware ACK & Action State
reason: Simulated ACK/failure behavior exists, but real hardware acknowledgements have not yet been validated.

title: Closed-Loop Feedback Intelligence
reason: Synthetic closed-loop testing exists, but validated pre/post physical intervention feedback requires real plants, sensors and actuator hardware.

title: Hailo Edge AI Deployment
reason: ONNX is ready, but final HEF regression and Raspberry Pi 5 + AI HAT+ runtime validation require the target Hailo environment/hardware.

title: Resource Optimization (<3 GB RAM)
reason: The final <3 GB acceptance criterion must be measured during target-edge runtime stability testing.

title: Adaptive Image Sampling
reason: Adaptive image-sampling policy is computer-side implementable but currently has no direct implementation evidence.

title: Edge Benchmarking
reason: Final preprocessing/Hailo/postprocessing/end-to-end latency and device resource measurements require the target edge hardware.

title: Long-Run Stability Test
reason: Final long-run stability acceptance requires real edge runtime and hardware camera/sensor behavior.

title: Failure & Safe-State Engine
reason: Safe blocking and simulator regression exist, but the complete failure matrix including all camera/network/database/hardware scenarios is not yet closed.

title: Data Logging & Audit Layer
reason: Audit database exists, but the full authoritative table/traceability schema covering risk, forecasts, commands, actions and sustainability is unfinished.

title: Model & System Versioning (MLOps-Lite)
reason: Vision models/configs/hashes are strongly versioned, but system-wide fusion, forecast, API and final-release versioning cannot be complete yet.

title: AI Testing Infrastructure
reason: Unit/regression tests exist, but the complete image+sensor+fusion+risk+forecast+decision+API+DB+simulated-hardware integration suite is not yet possible.

title: Sensor & Hardware Simulators
reason: Computer-side sensor/actuator simulation and deterministic simulated hardware behavior are implemented.

title: Ablation Study
reason: Required SENSOR ONLY vs VISION ONLY vs FUSION ablation cannot run until the three comparable baselines exist.

title: Temporal & Predictive Evaluation
reason: Software evaluation framework can be prepared, but meaningful temporal forecast validation and lead-time evidence require real temporal plant data.

title: Sustainability Intelligence Layer
reason: Sustainability analytics engine and measured-vs-estimated baseline methodology still need computer-side implementation; real savings remain future evidence.

title: Backend & Frontend Intelligence Outputs
reason: Backend/API outputs exist, but final risk/trend/forecast/sustainability and system-health intelligence fields are not fully backed by completed modules.

title: System Monitoring & Lightweight Drift Monitoring
reason: Lightweight prediction/sensor/resource distribution drift monitoring remains to be implemented.

title: Final Release & Team Handoffs
reason: Final packaged release, install/start scripts, complete handoff schemas and README can only be finalized after remaining computer-side modules are closed.
